**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. A customer service chatbot is deployed on the support portal. AI visual inspection is in pilot on the German production line. AI sales forecasting is planned for next year. An internal audit finding in June 2026 recorded no inventory of AI systems. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027."

**What the Briefing covers for Tamarack Instruments**

The Briefing will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each of the three use cases. All regulatory points are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. For the chatbot we will cover transparency expectations. For visual inspection we will test whether a high-risk classification could apply. We will also show how the requirement that customer data stay in the EU shapes vendor and hosting choices. United States developments appear only as a general landscape item. We will set out what an AI system inventory involves in practice. We will also place consultation with the German works council, before anything touches production staff, on the path to production.

The governance operating model draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-layer guidance comes from AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). We will show where ISO/IEC 42001 preparation can begin, with no promise of certification or audit outcomes. Throughout, the session applies three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and price**

The Executive Briefing runs for two hours, live and virtual, for executive leadership and board-level attendees. It is designed for an audience of the General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The price is US$3,000. The session date is Unknown and will be confirmed at intake. At intake we will also confirm two points:

1. How the ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and ISO 9001 quality management system are expected to relate to AI governance.
2. When ISO/IEC 42001 work will start.

**What you receive afterward**

You will receive a follow-up memo. It records the decisions surfaced and our readiness observations. It also sets out three prioritized recommendations. Each recommendation is mapped to a next program option with its price, duration and proposed timeline.

**Next step**

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. Please reply with two or three candidate dates. We will then schedule a short intake call and confirm the session.

Kind regards,

AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
